delivered_state: boards as sold, unfinished, standard thickness
constituents: wood strands incl. moisture; pMDI/MUF binder; paraffin wax and additives
constituent_sources: median of Egger EPD-EGG-20240403-IBD2 (https://cdn.byggtjeneste.no/nobb/5d36f435-3690-467d-bea3-7316879f18da), Sonae Arauco EPD-SON-20220209 (https://www.sonaearauco.com/media/huhpryfz/epd_osb_oriented-strand-board_val2027.pdf), Kronospan EPD-KRO-20230157-CBA1 (https://medias.groupe-samse.fr/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire_892469.pdf)
manufacturing_steps: debarking; flaking into strands; drying strands to 3-4 % moisture; screening; blending with resin and wax; forming/orienting mat; continuous hot pressing; trimming and cutting; cooling in star cooler; stacking/conditioning; cut-to-size and optional sanding; packaging

constituents: hemp shives (incl. moisture); calcareous binder (hydraulic lime + minor hardener)
constituent_sources: Schönthaler EPD BAU-EPD-SCHOENTHALER-2025-1 Table 2, midpoints of 20-55 % / 45-80 % (https://www.bau-epd.at/fileadmin/user_upload/epds_Deutsch/BAU-EPD-SCHOENTHALER-2025-1-ECOINVENT-Hanfsteine-20250923_Webseite.pdf)
manufacturing_steps: batch mixing of shives, binder and water; moulding/pressing in concrete-block forming machine; air drying; palletising | D5 route: per kg block 0.002 kWh electricity + 0.0216 MJ diesel (ecoinvent 'concrete block production' DE, same forming-plant process per EPD)
steps_source: Schönthaler EPD §2.6 (https://www.bau-epd.at/fileadmin/user_upload/epds_Deutsch/BAU-EPD-SCHOENTHALER-2025-1-ECOINVENT-Hanfsteine-20250923_Webseite.pdf); route energy: ecoinvent 3.12 concrete block production DE

manufacturing_steps: grinding into granules; autoclave expansion/agglomeration with superheated steam; cooling with water; stabilisation; cutting; packing | A1-A3 by D6 proxy (cork slab RER), route not built
